name: NewPatientIntake
title: New Patient Intake
description: Intake form completed by new patients before their first visit.

extension.valueMarkdown: Showcase of every Questionnaire Builder v2 feature except header and footer. Reviewed by the front desk before the first visit.

item.text: Welcome! Please complete this form before your first visit. It takes about 15 minutes.
Your answers are confidential. They are stored securely and only shared with your care team.
The name you would like us to call you, if different.
For example a maiden name. This helps us find your previous records.
As recorded on your insurance or ID documents.
How would you like the interpreter to join?
Patients under 18 need a parent or guardian to complete this section.
We will text appointment reminders to this number.
Link to records held by another provider
If another clinic's patient portal gave you a sharing link, paste it here.
How will you pay for your visits?
Photo of the front of your insurance card
Photo of the back of your insurance card
Please bring your insurance card to your first visit.
What is the main reason for your visit?
Which of these have you had in the past two weeks?
How would you rate your pain right now?
Have you ever been diagnosed with any of these?
How many times were you admitted to hospital in the past year?
Which specialists do you currently see?
Type to search, or enter one that isn't listed.
Do you take any medications, vitamins or supplements?
Has a parent, brother, sister or child had any of these?
How many alcoholic drinks do you have in a typical week?
One drink is a can of beer, a glass of wine or a shot of spirits.
How many hours do you sleep on a typical night?
Most adults need 7 or more hours of sleep. Your clinician can help if you have trouble sleeping.
What time do you usually go to bed?
Do you use any of these?
In a typical week, how often do you…
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
